plan: Fire and Fighting into a Steel/Rock fossil room, with Ground that does not hit my own partner. Chi-Yu's Heat Wave is the spread Fire lane that melts Metagross, Duraludon, Armaldo and Cradily at once and bypasses nothing important; Beads of Ruin drops the room's special bulk. Incineroar's Intimidate blunts Meteor Mash and Stone Edge, Fake Out buys the first Heat Wave, Knock Off removes the Assault Vest and the Weakness Policy before it can trigger. Urshifu's Unseen Fist ignores Cradily's and Armaldo's Protect, and Wicked Blow's guaranteed crit ignores Cradily's Recover math and any Meteor Mash Attack boosts. Amoonguss Spore removes one body and Rage Powder redirects - except against Duraludon, whose Stalwart is the authored check. Flutter Mane outspeeds the whole room.
